questions.explanation: 上文问假期计划，后文提到西湖（在杭州），回答去杭州旅行，选I'm going to take a trip to Hangzhou。
上文问交通方式，后文描述“fast and comfortable”，选I plan to go by high-speed train。
下文回答“For about five days.”表示一段时间，用How long提问，选How long are you going to stay there?。
下文回答“Yes, I am going to buy some beautiful tea...”，问是否买纪念品，选Are you going to buy any souvenirs there?。
对话最后表达美好祝愿，B表示感谢，选Have a good trip!。

text:
A: Good morning! Welcome to our school. My name is Dale. ___1___
B: Good morning! My name is Helen. Nice to meet you, Dale.
A: Nice to meet you, too. ___2___
B: I'm from England. I just arrived in China last week.
A: Welcome to China! What class are you in?
B: ___3___ We are classmates!
A: Really? That's great! Who is our English teacher?
B: ___4___ She is very kind.
A: Oh, I see. What's that in your hand?
B: ___5___ I like reading very much.
translation: A：早上好！欢迎来到我们学校。我叫戴尔。你叫什么名字？ B：早上好！我叫海伦。很高兴见到你，戴尔。 A：我也很高兴见到你。你来自哪里？ B：我来自英国。我上周刚到中国。 A：欢迎来到中国！你在哪个班级？ B：我在七年级一班。我们是同班同学！ A：真的吗？太棒了！我们的英语老师是谁？ B：我想是高老师。她非常和蔼。 A：哦，我明白了。你手里拿的是什么？ B：它是一本新书。我非常喜欢阅读。

questions.explanation: 下文回复“My name is Helen.”，询问姓名，选What's your name?
下文回复“I'm from England.”，询问来自哪里，选Where are you from?
上文问“What class are you in?”，后文说“We are classmates!”，选I'm in Class 1, Grade 7.
上文问英语老师是谁，选包含人物身份的选项，选I think it's Ms. Gao.
上文问手里是什么，后文说喜欢阅读，选It's a new book.

text:
A: Hi, Alice! You look happy today.
B: Hi, Frank! ___1___ My parents gave it to me for my birthday.
A: Oh, wow! It's beautiful. Is this your grandfather in the photo?
B: Yes, it is. He is very healthy.
A: ___2___
B: He is seventy years old. But he still exercises every day.
A: That's wonderful. ___3___
B: He usually plays chess or goes for a walk in the park.
A: Do you live with your grandparents?
B: ___4___ They live in a beautiful countryside.
A: Do you often visit them?
B: Yes. ___5___ We always have a good time together.
translation: A：嗨，爱丽丝！你今天看起来很高兴。 B：嗨，弗兰克！我看了一张我全家福的新照片。我父母把它作为生日礼物送给了我。 A：哦，哇！它真漂亮。照片里的这个人是你的爷爷吗？ B：是的，他是。他非常健康。 A：他多大岁数了？ B：他七十岁了。但他仍然每天锻炼身体。 A：那太好了。他通常做什么运动？ B：他通常在公园里下象棋或者散步。 A：你和你的祖父母住在一起吗？ B：不，我不和他们住在一起。他们住在一个美丽的乡村。 A：你经常去看望他们吗？ B：是的。我每周末都去看望他们。我们在一起总是过得很愉快。
options: What sports does he usually do?
No, I don't live with them.
I'm looking at a new photo of my family.
Who is the girl in red?

questions.explanation: 后文提到“in the photo”，说明前文提到了照片，选I'm looking at a new photo of my family.
下文回答“He is seventy years old.”，询问年龄，选How old is he?
下文回答“He usually plays chess or goes for a walk...”，询问活动，选What sports does he usually do?
上文是一般疑问句“Do you live with your grandparents?”，后文说明他们住在乡村，选No, I don't live with them.
上文问是否经常看望，答语“Yes.”后补充频率，选I visit them every weekend.

text:
A: Hi, Cindy! Welcome to my home. Come in, please.
B: Thanks, Bob. Wow, your living room is so clean and tidy!
A: Thank you. ___1___
B: It's beautiful. What's that on the wall?
A: ___2___ My father bought it last month.
B: It looks great. By the way, where is the kitchen? I want to wash my hands.
A: ___3___ Just follow me.
B: Okay. Is that your study next to the kitchen?
A: Yes, it is. There are many books in it. ___4___
B: I'd love to! I like reading science books. Do you have any?
A: Yes, I have a lot. ___5___ Let's go and choose some.
translation: A：嗨，辛迪！欢迎来到我家。请进。 B：谢谢，鲍勃。哇，你的客厅太干净整洁了！ A：谢谢。请在沙发上坐吧。 B：真漂亮。墙上的那个是什么？ A：它是一幅巨大的画。我父亲上个月买的。 B：它看起来棒极了。顺便问一下，厨房在哪里？我想洗手。 A：它在餐厅的后面。跟着我来就行。 B：好的。厨房旁边的那个是你的书房吗？ A：是的，它是。里面有很多书。你想进去看看吗？ B：我很乐意！我喜欢看科学类的书。你有一些吗？ A：有的，我有很多。它们都在大书架上。我们去挑几本吧。
options: Would you like to have a look inside?
They are all on the big bookshelf.

questions.explanation: 主人招待客人的礼貌用语，后文开始环顾客厅，选Please sit on the sofa.
上文问“What's that on the wall?”，回答墙上物品，选It's a big painting.
上文问厨房在哪里，回答方位，选It's behind the dining room.
后文回答“I'd love to!”表示接受邀请，结合前文书房有很多书，选Would you like to have a look inside?
上文问是否有科学书，回答后说明书的位置，选They are all on the big bookshelf.

text:
A: Good morning, doctor. ___1___ 
B: I have a headache and a sore throat. 
A: ___2___ 
B: Since yesterday evening. 
A: Let me check. ___3___ 
B: Yes, I feel a little cold. 
A: You have a cold. ___4___ 
B: What should I do? 
A: You should drink hot water and rest. ___5___ 
B: Thank you, doctor.
translation: A：早上好，医生。怎么了？ B：我头疼而且喉咙痛。 A：这样多久了？ B：从昨天晚上开始。 A：让我检查一下。你发烧了吗？ B：是的，我觉得有点冷。 A：你感冒了。你应该多喝热水并休息。 B：我该怎么办？ A：你应该喝热水并休息。一天吃三次药。 B：谢谢医生。
options: How long have you been like this?
Take this medicine three times a day.

questions.explanation: 根据答语“I have a headache and a sore throat.”询问病情，用What's the matter?
根据答语“Since yesterday evening.”询问持续时间，用How long have you been like this?
根据答语“Yes, I feel a little cold.”是一般疑问句，问是否发烧，用Do you have a fever?
后文“What should I do?”说明此处是医生给出建议，用Take this medicine three times a day.
根据答语“You should drink hot water and rest.”问该怎么办，用What should I do?

text:
A: Hi, Mary. ___1___ 
B: I'm going to volunteer at the animal hospital this weekend. 
A: ___2___ 
B: I will help to clean the cages and feed the animals. 
A: That sounds great. ___3___ 
B: Yes, I love animals very much. 
A: ___4___ 
B: I volunteer there twice a month. 
A: ___5___ 
B: Of course! You can come with me next time.
translation: A：你好，玛丽。你这个周末打算做什么？ B：我打算去动物医院做志愿者。 A：你会做什么？ B：我会帮忙清理笼子和喂动物。 A：听起来很棒。你喜欢动物吗？ B：是的，我非常喜欢动物。 A：你多久去那里做一次志愿者？ B：我一个月去两次。 A：我能和你一起去吗？ B：当然！下次你可以和我一起去。
options: What are you going to do this weekend?
How often do you volunteer there?

questions.explanation: 根据答语“I'm going to volunteer at the animal hospital this weekend.”询问周末计划，用What are you going to do this weekend?
根据答语“I will help to clean the cages and feed the animals.”询问具体做什么，用What will you do there?
根据答语“Yes, I love animals very much.”是一般疑问句，问是否喜欢动物，用Do you like animals?
根据答语“I volunteer there twice a month.”询问频率，用How often do you volunteer there?
根据答语“Of course! You can come with me next time.”是请求同行，用Can I go with you?

text:
A: Hi, Peter. ___1___ 
B: I'm reading a book about inventors. 
A: ___2___ 
B: It's about Thomas Edison. 
A: ___3___ 
B: He invented the light bulb. 
A: ___4___ 
B: He was born in 1847. 
A: ___5___ 
B: I think he is a great inventor.
translation: A：你好，彼得。你在读什么？ B：我在读一本关于发明家的书。 A：它是关于谁的？ B：是关于托马斯·爱迪生的。 A：他发明了什么？ B：他发明了电灯泡。 A：他什么时候出生的？ B：他出生于1847年。 A：你认为他怎么样？ B：我认为他是一位伟大的发明家。
options: What do you think of him?

questions.explanation: 根据答语“I'm reading a book about inventors.”询问在读什么，用What are you reading?
根据答语“It's about Thomas Edison.”询问关于谁，用Who is it about?
根据答语“He invented the light bulb.”询问发明了什么，用What did he invent?
根据答语“He was born in 1847.”询问出生时间，用When was he born?
根据答语“I think he is a great inventor.”询问看法，用What do you think of him?

text:
A: Hi, Li Rui! I hear your hometown has changed a lot. ___1___
B: No, it isn't. Great changes have taken place in the last twenty years.
A: Really? ___2___
B: People used to travel by bike or on foot, because the roads were rough.
A: ___3___
B: Now we have a new highway, and it takes only an hour to get to the town.
A: ___4___
B: About fifteen minutes by bus. My school is near my home.
A: ___5___
B: No, there wasn't. People had to go to the city to see a doctor.
translation: A：嗨，李瑞！我听说你的家乡变化很大。你的家乡还是和以前一样吗？ B：不，不是了。过去二十年发生了巨大的变化。 A：真的吗？过去人们怎么出行？ B：人们过去骑自行车或步行，因为道路崎岖不平。 A：现在呢？ B：现在我们有了新的公路，到镇上只需要一个小时。 A：到你学校需要多长时间？ B：坐公交车大约十五分钟。我学校离家很近。 A：过去镇上有医院吗？ B：不，没有。人们不得不去城里看病。
options: How long does it take to get to your school?
Was there a hospital in the town in the past?
Is your hometown still the same as before?
How did people travel in the past?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“No, it isn't.”，问“你的家乡还是和以前一样吗”，选Is your hometown still the same as before?
下文说“People used to travel by bike or on foot”，问过去出行方式，选How did people travel in the past?
前文描述过去交通，下文说“Now we have a new highway”，问“现在呢”，选What about now?
下文回答“About fifteen minutes by bus.”，问路程时间，选How long does it take to get to your school?
下文回答“No, there wasn't.”，问过去是否有医院，选Was there a hospital in the town in the past?

text:
A: Hi, Mike! I hear you had a fight with your best friend. ___1___
B: Yes. I borrowed his favorite book and lost it. He was very angry.
A: I see. ___2___ You should say sorry to him.
B: I know, but I'm afraid he won't forgive me.
A: Don't worry. ___3___ True friends always understand each other.
B: You're right. ___4___
A: You can also buy him a new copy of the book.
B: Good idea. ___5___
A: You're welcome. I hope you can be friends again soon.
translation: A：嗨，迈克！我听说你和最好的朋友吵架了。发生什么事了？ B：是的。我借了他最喜欢的书，然后弄丢了。他非常生气。 A：我明白了。你应该向他道歉。 B：我知道，但我怕他不会原谅我。 A：别担心。真诚的道歉会有帮助。真正的朋友总是互相理解。 B：你说得对。我该怎么做？ A：你也可以给他买一本新书。 B：好主意。谢谢你的建议。 A：不客气。我希望你们能很快和好。
options: You should say sorry to him.

questions.explanation: 下文描述了冲突经过，问“发生什么事了”，选What happened?
后文紧接着说“You should say sorry to him.”，此处给出道歉建议，选You should say sorry to him.
安慰后说明道歉的作用，与后文“True friends always understand each other.”衔接，选A sincere apology will help.
说“You're right.”后问下一步怎么办，回答“You can also buy him a new copy”，选What should I do?
回答“You're welcome.”，说明此处表示感谢，选Thanks for your advice.

text:
A: Hi, Emma! You look nervous. ___1___
B: I'm going to a dinner party at my Chinese friend's home. But I don't know what to do.
A: Don't worry. ___2___ For example, you should arrive on time.
B: OK. ___3___
A: You should bring a small gift, like some fruit or flowers.
B: Good idea. ___4___
A: At the dinner table, you should wait for the host to start eating first.
B: I see. ___5___
A: You're welcome. Enjoy the party!
translation: A：嗨，艾玛！你看起来很紧张。怎么了？ B：我要去一个中国朋友家参加晚宴。但我不知道该怎么办。 A：别担心。这里有一些建议。例如，你应该准时到达。 B：好的。我应该带礼物吗？ A：你应该带一个小礼物，比如一些水果或花。 B：好主意。在餐桌上我该怎么做？ A：在餐桌上，你应该等主人先开始吃。 B：我明白了。谢谢你的建议。 A：不客气。祝你在聚会上玩得开心！
options: What should I do at the dinner table?

questions.explanation: 下文说“I'm going to a dinner party... But I don't know what to do.”，问“怎么了”，选What's wrong?
安慰后开始给建议，后文“For example, you should arrive on time.”是具体例子，选Here are some suggestions.
下文回答“You should bring a small gift”，问是否应该带礼物，选Should I bring a gift?
下文回答“At the dinner table, you should wait for the host to start eating first.”，问餐桌上怎么做，选What should I do at the dinner table?
回答“You're welcome.”，此处表示感谢，选Thanks for your advice.

text:
A: Hi, I'm Chris. Nice to meet you!
B: Oh, hi, I'm Amy. ___1___
A: So, Amy. Why are you interested in joining our group?
B: Well, I want to do something for our environment.
A: ___2___ We are all trying to live a low-carbon life.
B: A low-carbon life? What is that?
A: It's a green lifestyle. ___3___ We still buy daily things like food and drinks. But we try not to buy new clothes or shoes.
B: Wow! ___4___
A: Well, we eat less meat and we prefer more local food.
B: I can do that. And I often take a bus to school.
A: That's great. Then welcome to join us.
B: ___5___ Thanks.
translation: A：嗨，我是克里斯。很高兴见到你！ B：哦，嗨，我是艾米。我也很高兴见到你。 A：那么，艾米。你为什么有兴趣加入我们小组？ B：嗯，我想为环境做点事。 A：这个小组正好适合你。我们都在努力过低碳生活。 B：低碳生活？那是什么？ A：这是一种绿色生活方式。我们从减少购物开始。我们仍然买食物和饮料等日常用品，但我们尽量不买新衣服或鞋子。 B：哇！还有别的吗？ A：嗯，我们少吃肉，更喜欢当地食物。 B：我可以做到。而且我经常坐公交车上学。 A：太好了。那么欢迎加入我们。 B：我很乐意。谢谢。
options: It's great to see you, too.
This group is just right for you.
Can you lend me a bike?

questions.explanation: A说“Nice to meet you!”，回应“我也很高兴见到你”，选It's great to see you, too.
B说想为环境做事，A表示小组正适合她，选This group is just right for you.
后文围绕购物展开，说明低碳生活从减少购物开始，选We start with less shopping.
B发出感叹后，A继续补充，说明B在问还有没有其他做法，选Anything else?
A说“welcome to join us”，B回应“Thanks.”，表示乐意加入，选I'd love to.

text:
A: Hi, Li Hua! The Spring Festival is coming. ___1___
B: Yes, my family is very busy these days.
A: ___2___
B: We clean the house, buy new clothes and prepare lots of food.
A: What food do you usually prepare?
B: ___3___ We also make dumplings together.
A: That sounds great. ___4___
B: We usually have a big dinner on New Year's Eve. All the family members get together.
A: ___5___
B: Yes, children get red packets from their parents and grandparents.
translation: A：嗨，李华！春节要到了。你们忙吗？ B：是的，我家这些天很忙。 A：你们在忙什么？ B：我们打扫房子、买新衣服、准备很多食物。 A：你们通常准备什么食物？ B：我们通常准备鸡、鱼和肉。我们还一起包饺子。 A：听起来很棒。你们通常怎么庆祝？ B：我们通常在除夕吃一顿大餐。所有家庭成员聚在一起。 A：孩子们能收到红包吗？ B：是的，孩子们从父母和祖父母那里收到红包。
options: Are you busy with the Spring Festival?
We usually prepare chicken, fish and meat.
How do you usually celebrate it?

questions.explanation: B回答“Yes, my family is very busy these days.”，问是否忙着准备春节，选Are you busy with the Spring Festival?
B回答“We clean the house, buy new clothes and prepare lots of food.”，问在忙什么，选What are you busy doing?
A问“What food do you usually prepare?”，列举食物，选We usually prepare chicken, fish and meat.
B回答“We usually have a big dinner on New Year's Eve.”，问如何庆祝，选How do you usually celebrate it?
B回答“Yes, children get red packets...”，问孩子们是否收到红包，选Do children get red packets?

text:
A: Hi, Alice! You look unhappy. ___1___
B: I argued with my best friend. She is angry with me now.
A: ___2___
B: I borrowed her favorite book and lost it.
A: I see. ___3___ You should say sorry to her.
B: I know, but I'm afraid she won't forgive me.

A: You can also buy her a new copy of the book.

options: You should say sorry to her.
Did you buy her a gift?

questions.explanation: B描述“I argued with my best friend.”，问怎么了，选What's wrong?
B解释“I borrowed her favorite book and lost it.”，问发生什么事了，选What happened?
理解情况后给出具体建议，后文“You should say sorry to her”直接衔接，选You should say sorry to her.
B担心朋友不原谅，A安慰别担心，选Don't worry.
A回答“You can also buy her a new copy of the book.”，问还能做什么，选What else can I do?

text:
A: Hi, Mike! ___1___
B: I'm going to the library. I want to borrow some books about animals.

options: Why do you need those books?

questions.explanation: B回答“I'm going to the library.”，问去哪里，选Where are you going?

B回答“I plan to finish it this weekend.”，问什么时候完成，选When are you going to finish it?
B回答“Thank you.”，表达祝愿，选Good luck with your report.

text:
A: Hi, David! ___1___
B: I'm going to be an engineer when I grow up.
A: ___2___
B: Because I like building things and solving problems.
A: That's a great dream. ___3___
B: I'm going to study math and science hard.
A: ___4___
B: I'm going to start by joining the science club at school.
A: ___5___
B: Thank you. I will try my best.
translation: A：嗨，大卫！你长大后想做什么？ B：我长大后想成为一名工程师。 A：为什么？ B：因为我喜欢建造东西和解决问题。 A：那是个伟大的梦想。你打算怎么实现它？ B：我打算努力学数学和科学。 A：你打算怎么开始？ B：我打算从参加学校的科学俱乐部开始。 A：祝你好运。 B：谢谢。我会尽力的。
options: What are you going to be when you grow up?
Why do you want to be an engineer?
How are you going to do that?
How are you going to start?
When are you going to start?

questions.explanation: B回答“I'm going to be an engineer when I grow up.”，问职业理想，选What are you going to be when you grow up?

options: Are there any other rules in our school?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“There are many rules. For example...”，问学校是否有其他规则，选Are there any other rules in our school?
在音乐室听音乐是合理的，后文用But转折说不能在教室听，此处肯定回答，选Yes, you can.
后文解释必须穿校服，意味着不能随意戴帽子，否定回答，选No, you can't.
问放学后必须做什么，后文提到“Keeping the school clean”，与打扫卫生有关，选You must clean the classrooms.
学生抱怨规则多有压力，老师安慰并指出规则的积极作用，选Rules are good for us.

text:
A: Hi, Peter! Can you play the guitar?
B: No, I can't. ___1___ I want to join the music club.
A: Oh, the music club is great. My brother is in that club.
B: Really? ___2___
A: He can play the drums and the piano.
B: Wow, he is so talented! ___3___
A: I want to join the chess club. I think playing chess is very interesting.
B: That sounds cool. ___4___
A: Yes, I can play it well. My grandfather taught me.
B: Great! ___5___
A: Sure. Let's go and sign up now.
translation: A：嗨，彼得！你会弹吉他吗？ B：不，我不会。但是我喜欢唱歌。我想加入音乐俱乐部。 A：哦，音乐俱乐部太棒了。我哥哥就在那个俱乐部。 B：真的吗？他会做什么？ A：他会敲鼓和弹钢琴。 B：哇，他真有天赋！你想加入什么俱乐部？ A：我想加入象棋俱乐部。我觉得下象棋很有趣。 B：听起来很酷。你会下象棋吗？ A：是的，我下得很好。我爷爷教我的。 B：太好了！我们能今天下午一起去俱乐部吗？ A：当然可以。我们现在去报名吧。
options: What club do you want to join?
Can we go to the club together this afternoon?

questions.explanation: 后文说“I want to join the music club”，虽然不会弹吉他但喜欢音乐相关活动，转折连词But符合逻辑，选But I like singing.
下文回答“He can play the drums and the piano”，问能力，选What can he do?
下文回答“I want to join the chess club”，问俱乐部意向，选What club do you want to join?
下文肯定回答“Yes, I can play it well”，问下象棋能力，选Can you play chess?
下文答语“Sure. Let's go...”表示应允，此处发出共同前往的邀请，选Can we go to the club together this afternoon?

text:
A: Hello, welcome to the Noodle House! ___1___
B: Yes, please. I'd like a bowl of noodles.
A: What size bowl of noodles would you like?
B: ___2___
A: OK. And what kind of noodles would you like?
B: ___3___
A: Beef and tomato noodles, large size. Would you like anything to drink?
B: ___4___ A glass of orange juice, please.
A: No problem. Anything else?
B: No, that's all. ___5___
A: They are twenty-five yuan in total.
translation: A：你好，欢迎光临面馆！你想点菜吗？ B：是的。我想来一碗面条。 A：你想要多大碗的面条？ B：我想要大碗的。 A：好的。你想要哪种面条？ B：我想要牛肉番茄面。 A：牛肉番茄面，大碗。你想喝点什么吗？ B：是的，请给我一杯橙汁。 A：没问题。还要别的吗？ B：不要了，就这些。它们总共多少钱？ A：总共25元。
options: I'd like beef and tomato noodles.

questions.explanation: 服务员接待顾客的常规用语，下文回答“Yes, please. I'd like...”，询问是否点餐，选May I take your order?
上文问“What size bowl...?”，问尺寸，选I'd like a large bowl.
上文问“what kind of noodles...?”，后文复述“Beef and tomato noodles”，选I'd like beef and tomato noodles.
上文问“Would you like anything to drink?”，下文指明要橙汁，先肯定答复，选Yes, please.
下文回答“They are twenty-five yuan in total”，问价格，选How much are they?

text:
A: Hi, Linda! What are you watching on TV?
B: ___1___ I think it's very funny and it always makes me laugh.
A: Oh, I like comedies too. Do you like talk shows?
B: No, I can't stand them. ___2___
A: I don't agree. I think they are educational. What do you think of soap operas?
B: ___3___ The stories are too boring and never change.
A: Well, I think some news programs are better. Do you watch the news?
B: ___4___ My father watches the news every evening, but I prefer cartoons.
A: I see. By the way, there is a talent show on Channel 5 tonight. Do you want to watch it?
B: ___5___ I plan to finish my homework first, then watch it with my sister.
translation: A：嗨，琳达！你在电视上看什么呢？ B：我正在看一部新喜剧。我觉得它非常搞笑，总是能逗我发笑。 A：哦，我也喜欢喜剧。你喜欢脱口秀吗？ B：不，我受不了脱口秀。我觉得它们很无聊。 A：我不赞同。我觉得它们很有教育意义。你觉得肥皂剧怎么样？ B：我完全不喜欢它们。故事情节太无聊了，而且千篇一律。 A：嗯，我觉得一些新闻节目更好。你看新闻吗？ B：并不经常看。我父亲每天晚上都看新闻，但我更喜欢动画片。 A：我明白了。顺便说一下，今晚5频道有一个才艺秀。你想看吗？ B：我很乐意看。我计划先做完作业，然后和我妹妹一起看。
points: 表达对电视节目的看法
options: I don't like them at all.
I think they are meaningless and boring.

questions.explanation: 后文提到“funny”并属于喜剧，说明正在看喜剧，选I'm watching a new comedy.
上文说受不了脱口秀，下文A反驳说“很有教育意义”，说明B认为脱口秀无聊，选I think they are meaningless and boring.
后文说故事太无聊，态度否定，选I don't like them at all.
后文转折说父亲每天看而自己更喜欢动画片，说明自己不常看，选Not very often.
后文给出观看计划，说明想看，选I'd love to watch it.

text:
A: Hi, Peter. ___1___
B: I'm reading a book about inventors.
A: ___2___
B: It's about Thomas Edison.
A: ___3___
B: He invented the light bulb.
A: ___4___
B: He was born in 1847.
A: ___5___
B: I think he is a great inventor.
translation: A：你好，彼得。你在读什么？ B：我在读一本关于发明家的书。 A：它是关于谁的？ B：是关于托马斯·爱迪生的。 A：他发明了什么？ B：他发明了电灯泡。 A：他什么时候出生的？ B：他出生于1847年。 A：你认为他怎么样？ B：我认为他是一位伟大的发明家。
options: What do you think of him?

questions.explanation: 根据答语“I'm reading a book about inventors.”询问在读什么，选What are you reading?
根据答语“It's about Thomas Edison.”询问关于谁，选Who is it about?
根据答语“He invented the light bulb.”询问发明了什么，选What did he invent?
根据答语“He was born in 1847.”询问出生时间，选When was he born?
根据答语“I think he is a great inventor.”询问看法，选What do you think of him?

text:
A: Hi, Lucy! Long time no see. ___1___
B: Great! I joined an environment protecting club. We went to all the parks in our city to collect rubbish these days.
A: ___2___ Can I join the club to protect the environment?
B: Of course you can. We can also protect the environment in our daily life.
A: What should I do?
B: ___3___ You should put the rubbish in the dustbin.
A: What else should I do?
B: Second, you can plant trees. ___4___
A: That sounds easy.
B: ___5___
translation: A：嗨，露西！好久不见。你最近怎么样？ B：很好！我加入了一个环保俱乐部。这些天我们去了城市里所有的公园收集垃圾。 A：多么美妙的经历啊！我能加入俱乐部来保护环境吗？ B：当然可以。我们在日常生活中也可以保护环境。 A：我应该做什么？ B：首先，你不应该到处乱扔垃圾。你应该把垃圾放进垃圾桶。 A：还应该做什么？ B：第二，你可以种树。树木可以阻止风把泥土吹走。 A：听起来很容易。 B：说起来容易做起来难。
options: Trees can stop the wind from blowing the earth away.
First, you shouldn't leave rubbish here and there.
I can do what I love to do.

questions.explanation: B回答“Great!”并介绍近况，问最近怎么样，选How is it going?
B描述参与环保活动的经历，A发出赞叹，选What a wonderful experience!
后文说“Second, you can plant trees.”，此处是第一条建议，选First, you shouldn't leave rubbish here and there.
前文说“you can plant trees”，解释种树的作用，选Trees can stop the wind from blowing the earth away.
A说“That sounds easy.”，B用谚语回应，表示实际做起来不容易，选Easier said than done.

text:
A: Hi, Jack! You look tired. ___1___
B: I stayed up late to finish my science project.
A: ___2___ How long did you sleep last night?
B: Only about four hours.
A: ___3___ You need at least eight hours of sleep.
B: I know. But I have to hand it in tomorrow.
A: ___4___ You can finish the rest after a short rest.
B: That's a good idea. ___5___
A: You're welcome. Take care of yourself.
translation: A：嗨，杰克！你看起来很累。怎么了？ B：我熬夜完成科学项目。 A：那对健康不好。你昨晚睡了多久？ B：只有大约四个小时。 A：你应该多睡觉。你至少需要八个小时的睡眠。 B：我知道。但我明天必须交。 A：你应该休息一下。你可以休息一会儿后再完成剩下的。 B：好主意。谢谢你的建议。 A：不客气。照顾好自己。
options: Why don't you go to bed early?
How much sleep do you need?

questions.explanation: B解释熬夜，问怎么了，选What's the matter?
得知熬夜后给出评价，后文问睡眠时长，选That's bad for your health.
B说只睡四小时，建议多睡觉，选You should get more sleep.
B说必须明天交，建议先休息，后文“after a short rest”呼应，选You should take a rest.
A回答“You're welcome.”，此处表示感谢，选Thanks for your advice.

text:
A: Hi, Sam! Who is your best friend in our class?
B: It's Tom. We often study and play games together.
A: I know Tom. He is very outgoing. ___1___
B: Yes, we are both into sports. But I think I am a bit more serious than him.
A: Really? ___2___
B: Tom is much funnier. He always tells jokes and makes everyone laugh.
A: That's true. He is very popular. Is he as hard-working as you?
B: No, I don't think so. ___3___
A: I agree. You always get better grades in exams. ___4___
B: I think a good friend should be talented and trustworthy. Also, they should bring out the best in you.
A: Well said! ___5___
B: Yes. Although we have some differences, we always support each other.
translation: A：嗨，山姆！我们班你最好的朋友是谁？ B：是汤姆。我们经常一起学习、玩游戏。 A：我认识汤姆。他非常外向。你们有相似之处吗？ B：有的，我们都喜欢运动。但我认为我比他稍微严肃一点。 A：真的吗？那谁更幽默呢？ B：汤姆要幽默得多。他总是讲笑话，逗每个人发笑。 A：确实如此。他很受欢迎。他像你一样努力吗？ B：不，我不这么认为。我比他学得更努力。他经常在学习时走神。 A：我同意。你总是在考试中取得更好的成绩。你认为一个好朋友应该是什么样的？ B：我认为一个好朋友应该是有才华且值得信赖的。并且，他们应该能激发出你最好的一面。 A：说得真好！这就是你和汤姆相处得这么好的原因吗？ B：是的。尽管我们有一些不同，但我们总是互相支持。
options: What do you think a good friend should be like?
Is that why you and Tom get along so well?
Do you have anything in common?
I think friends are not necessary.

questions.explanation: 下文回答“Yes, we are both into sports”，问是否有共同点，选Do you have anything in common?
下文回答“Tom is much funnier”，问谁更幽默，选Then who is funnier?
问汤姆是否和山姆一样努力，否定后说明自己更努力，选I study harder than him.
下文陈述对好朋友标准的看法，问好朋友应该是什么样，选What do you think a good friend should be like?
下文回答“Yes. Although we have some differences...”，推测这是相处融洽的原因，选Is that why you and Tom get along so well?

text:
A: Hi, Mary! I want to go out for dinner tonight. Do you have any suggestions?
B: ___1___ It has the most delicious beef noodles in town.
A: Sounds good. Is it expensive?
B: No, the prices are very reasonable. ___2___
A: That's perfect. How is the service there?
B: ___3___ The waiters are always friendly and serve the food quickly.
A: Great. How can I get there from our school?
B: ___4___ It takes about ten minutes. It's next to the cinema.
A: OK, I think I will walk there. By the way, what's the most popular theater nearby?
B: Wanda Theater. ___5___ The seats are also the most comfortable.
translation: A：嗨，玛丽！我想今晚出去吃晚饭。你有什么建议吗？ B：为什么不试试天天面馆呢？它有全镇最美味的牛肉面。 A：听起来不错。它贵吗？ B：不，价格非常合理。它是我们社区里最便宜的餐馆。 A：那太完美了。那里的服务怎么样？ B：它的服务也是最好的。服务员总是很友好，上菜也很快。 A：太棒了。从我们学校怎么去那里？ B：你可以直接步行去那里。大约需要十分钟。它就在电影院旁边。 A：好的，我想我会步行去。顺便问一下，附近最受欢迎的影院是哪家？ B：万达影院。它有全城最大的屏幕。座位也是最舒适的。
options: Its service is also the best.
Why not try Tiantian Noodle House?
It has the biggest screen in the city.
It is the cheapest restaurant in our neighborhood.

questions.explanation: 上文要求给建议，后文提到面条，用Why not提出建议，选Why not try Tiantian Noodle House?
上文说价格合理，顺承价格话题用最高级说明最便宜，选It is the cheapest restaurant in our neighborhood.
上文问服务质量，后文说服务员友好、上菜快，选Its service is also the best.
下文A说决定步行，建议步行去，选You can just walk there.
后文提到座位最舒适，继续用最高级列举突出优势，选It has the biggest screen in the city.

text:
A: Hi, Tony! ___1___
B: I'm going to the sports center. I want to play basketball.
A: ___2___
B: About twice a week. It helps me stay fit.
A: That's great. ___3___
B: My favorite player is Yao Ming. He is very tall and skillful.
A: I like him too. ___4___
B: Yes, I do. I watch his games whenever I have time.
A: ___5___
B: You can come with me next time. I can teach you some basic skills.
translation: A：嗨，托尼！你要去哪里？ B：我要去体育中心。我想打篮球。 A：你多久打一次篮球？ B：大约一周两次。它帮助我保持健康。 A：那很好。你最喜欢的球员是谁？ B：我最喜欢的球员是姚明。他非常高，技术也很好。 A：我也喜欢他。你经常看他的比赛吗？ B：是的。我一有时间就看他的比赛。 A：我也想学打篮球。 B：下次你可以和我一起去。我可以教你一些基本技巧。
options: How often do you play basketball?
Do you often watch his games?
I want to learn to play basketball too.
What time do you usually play?
Can you teach me to swim?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“I'm going to the sports center.”，问去哪里，选Where are you going?
下文回答“About twice a week.”，问频率，选How often do you play basketball?
下文回答“My favorite player is Yao Ming.”，问最喜欢的球员，选Who is your favorite player?
下文回答“Yes, I do. I watch his games...”，问是否经常看比赛，选Do you often watch his games?
下文说“You can come with me next time. I can teach you...”，表达想学打篮球，选I want to learn to play basketball too.

text:
A: Hi, Alice! Where did you go this summer vacation?
B: I went to Beijing.
A: ___1___
B: I went there with my friend, Jenny.
A: ___2___
B: Yes. As one of the best universities, it is really big and beautiful.
A: How was the food there?
B: ___3___
A: I heard that it was too hot in Beijing, wasn't it?
B: Yes. I tried swimming in Beidaihe. It made me kind of cool. ___4___
A: You'd better go to a Beijing hutong next time. Maybe it has fewer visitors.
B: Good idea. ___5___
A: I lived there for 3 years. I love Beijing. Do you want to go there again with me?
translation: A：嗨，爱丽丝。这个暑假你去哪儿了？ B：我去了北京。 A：你和谁一起去的？ B：我和我的朋友珍妮一起去的。 A：你参观北京大学了吗？ B：是的。作为最好的大学之一，它真的很大很美。 A：那里的食物怎么样？ B：北京烤鸭尝起来真的很美味。我甚至给父母买了一些。 A：我听说北京很热，是不是？ B：是的。我尝试了在北戴河游泳，让我凉快了些。但是人太多了。 A：下次你最好去北京的胡同。也许游客少一些。 B：好主意。你似乎对北京很了解。 A：我在那里住了三年。我爱北京。你想再和我一起去吗？
options: Oh, really? Who did you go with?
But there were so many people.
It seems that you know Beijing a lot.
Beijing duck tastes really delicious. I even bought some for my parents.
The weather in Beijing is nice.
I went to Shanghai last year.

questions.explanation: B回答“I went there with my friend, Jenny.”，问和谁一起去的，选Oh, really? Who did you go with?
B回答“Yes. As one of the best universities...”，问是否参观了北京大学，选Did you visit Peking University?
A问食物怎么样，B评价食物，选Beijing duck tastes really delicious. I even bought some for my parents.
B说完在北戴河游泳后补充了一个负面情况，与后文A建议去人少的地方衔接，选But there were so many people.
A回答“I lived there for 3 years.”，说明B感叹A对北京很了解，选It seems that you know Beijing a lot.

text:
A: What are you going to do for your summer vacation?
B: I'm going to travel with my friends.
A: ___1___
B: To Shanghai, Hangzhou and Suzhou.
A: ___2___
B: By car.
A: ___3___
B: The day after tomorrow.
A: ___4___
B: For about two weeks.
A: That sounds great. ___5___
B: Thank you!
translation: A：你暑假打算做什么？ B：我打算和朋友们去旅行。 A：你们要去哪里？ B：去上海、杭州和苏州。 A：你们怎么去？ B：开车去。 A：什么时候出发？ B：后天。 A：旅行会持续多久？ B：大约两周。 A：听起来很棒。祝你们玩得开心！ B：谢谢！
options: How long will the trip last?

questions.explanation: B回答“To Shanghai, Hangzhou and Suzhou.”，问目的地，选Where will you go?
B回答“By car.”，问交通方式，选How will you travel?
B回答“The day after tomorrow.”，问出发时间，选When are you leaving?
B回答“For about two weeks.”，问持续多久，选How long will the trip last?
B回答“Thank you!”，表达祝愿，选Have a good trip!

text:
A: Hi, Tracy! How is your summer vacation going?
B: ___1___
A: Wow, lucky you! That sounds amazing. ___2___
B: It's sunny and hot.
A: What are you doing now, Tracy?
B: ___3___
A: Wow, playing beach volleyball sounds cool. ___4___
B: My father is walking on the beach, and my mother is swimming.
A: That's nice. ___5___
translation: A：嗨，特蕾西！你的暑假过得怎么样？ B：太棒了！ A：哇，你真幸运！听起来太棒了。天气怎么样？ B：晴朗炎热。 A：特蕾西，你现在在做什么？ B：我正在打沙滩排球。 A：哇，打沙滩排球听起来很酷。你父母呢？ B：我爸爸在海滩上散步，我妈妈在游泳。 A：那真好。玩得开心！

questions.explanation: 问暑假过得怎么样，B回答很好，后文说“That sounds amazing.”，选It's wonderful!
B回答“It's sunny and hot.”，问天气，选How's the weather?
问“What are you doing now?”，用现在进行时回答，选I'm playing beach volleyball.
B回答父母正在做什么，问B父母在做什么，选What about your parents?
B回答“Thanks.”，表达祝愿，选Have a great time!

text:
A: Hello? This is Anna speaking.
B: Hi, Anna! It's Ben. ___1___
A: Not much. I'm having lunch. What about you?
B: ___2___ It's really interesting.
A: Watching TV again? ___3___
B: Yes, it's a sports show. I like watching basketball games.
A: ___4___
B: It's sunny and warm here in Jinan. How's the weather in your city?
A: ___5___ I hope it will be sunny tomorrow.
translation: A：你好？我是安娜。 B：嗨，安娜！我是本。你在做什么？ A：没什么。我在吃午饭。你呢？ B：我在看电视。真的很有趣。 A：又在看电视？你在看什么？ B：是的，是一个体育节目。我喜欢看篮球比赛。 A：你那里天气怎么样？ B：济南这里晴朗温暖。你所在的城市天气怎么样？ A：正在下雨。我希望明天会是晴天。

questions.explanation: 下文回答“Not much. I'm having lunch.”，问对方正在做什么，选What are you doing?
下文说“Watching TV again?”，此处应回答正在看电视，选I'm watching TV.
下文回答“Yes, it's a sports show.”，问在看什么节目，选What are you watching?
下文回答“It's sunny and warm here in Jinan.”，问天气，选How's the weather there?
上文问“How's the weather in your city?”，回答当地天气，后文说希望明天晴天，说明现在天气不好，选It's raining here.

text:
A: Hi, Yaming! How was your weekend?
B: ___1___ I went to the science museum with my cousin.
A: Really? ___2___
B: We saw a robot show and tried some hands-on experiments.
A: That sounds cool. ___3___
B: It was about two hours. We took the subway there.
A: ___4___
B: Yes, we did. We took a lot of photos.
A: Can I see them?
B: ___5___ I'll bring them to school tomorrow.
translation: A：嗨，亚明！你的周末怎么样？ B：很棒！我和表哥去了科学博物馆。 A：真的吗？你们在那里做了什么？ B：我们看了一场机器人表演，还尝试了一些动手实验。 A：听起来很酷。你们在那里待了多久？ B：大约两个小时。我们坐地铁去的。 A：你们拍照了吗？ B：是的，我们拍了很多。 A：我能看看吗？ B：当然。我明天带到学校来。
options: How long did you stay there?

questions.explanation: 下文说“I went to the science museum...”，评价周末，选It was great!
下文回答“We saw a robot show and tried...”，问在那里做了什么，选What did you do there?
下文回答“It was about two hours.”，问待了多久，选How long did you stay there?
下文回答“Yes, we did. We took a lot of photos.”，问是否拍照，选Did you take any photos?
上文问“Can I see them?”，表示同意，选Sure.

text:
A: Hi, Bill! You're reading this book again.
B: Yes, Tom. I really can't put it down.
A: ___1___
B: Three times. Every time I read it, I can always learn something new.
A: Really? ___2___
B: Charles Dickens. I think he is a great English writer.
A: ___3___ He is also my favorite foreign writer. What do you think of this book?
B: ___4___ Where did you buy it?
A: In Rose Bookshop. ___5___
B: OK, no problem. I'll show you the way.
translation: A：嗨，比尔！你又在读这本书。 B：是的，汤姆。我真的爱不释手。 A：你读过几遍？ B：三遍。每次读，我都能学到新东西。 A：真的吗？谁写的？ B：查尔斯·狄更斯。我认为他是一位伟大的英国作家。 A：我也这么认为。他也是我最喜欢的外国作家。你觉得这本书怎么样？ B：很精彩。你在哪里买的？ A：在玫瑰书店。你能告诉我怎么去吗？ B：好的，没问题。我给你指路。
options: How many times have you read it?
Could you show me the way?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“Three times.”，问读过几遍，选How many times have you read it?
下文回答“Charles Dickens.”，问作者，选Who wrote it?
后文说“He is also my favorite foreign writer.”，表示赞同，选I think so.
上文问“What do you think of this book?”，评价书，选It's wonderful.
下文回答“OK, no problem. I'll show you the way.”，请求指路，选Could you show me the way?

text:
A: Hi, Kate! Do you like ice cream?
B: Yes, I do. ___1___
A: Really? How do you make it?
B: ___2___ Then add some milk and sugar.
A: ___3___
B: Next, pour the mixture into a blender and turn it on.
A: ___4___
B: Finally, put it in the fridge for about two hours.
A: That sounds easy. ___5___
B: Sure! Let's make some together this weekend.
translation: A：嗨，凯特！你喜欢冰淇淋吗？ B：是的，我喜欢。我经常在家做。 A：真的吗？你怎么做？ B：首先，把一些水果切碎。然后加一些牛奶和糖。 A：接下来做什么？ B：接下来，把混合物倒入搅拌机并打开。 A：然后呢？ B：最后，把它放进冰箱大约两个小时。 A：听起来很简单。你能教我吗？ B：当然！这周末我们一起做一些吧。
options: I often make it at home.

questions.explanation: 下文问“How do you make it?”，说明B提到自己会做，选I often make it at home.
下文说“Then add some milk and sugar.”，此处是制作的第一步，选First, cut up some fruit.
下文说“Next, pour the mixture...”，问下一步做什么，选What's next?
下文说“Finally, put it in the fridge...”，问然后呢，选And then?
下文回答“Sure! Let's make some together...”，请求对方教自己，选Can you teach me?

text:
A: Hi, Linda! You just came back from France. ___1___
B: It was great, but I made a few mistakes because of the cultural differences.
A: Really? ___2___
B: Well, I arrived at the party on time, but the host looked a little surprised. ___3___
A: Oh, in France, guests usually arrive a little later. What else?
B: I brought a gift, but I opened it in front of the host. ___4___
A: I see. In France, people often open gifts in private. ___5___
B: Yes, I also talked about salary with a French friend. That was not polite.
translation: A：嗨，琳达！你刚从法国回来。你的旅行怎么样？ B：很棒，但因为文化差异我犯了一些错误。 A：真的吗？发生什么事了？ B：嗯，我准时到了派对，但主人看起来有点惊讶。我做错了什么吗？ A：哦，在法国，客人通常会晚一点到。还有呢？ B：我带了礼物，但我在主人面前打开了它。那也不礼貌吗？ A：我明白了。在法国，人们通常私下打开礼物。还有其他文化差异吗？ B：是的，我还和一位法国朋友谈了工资。那是不礼貌的。
options: How long did you stay there?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“It was great, but...”，问旅行怎么样，选How was your trip?
下文描述在派对上犯的错误，问发生了什么，选What happened?
上文说主人看起来惊讶，B询问自己是否做错了什么，选Did I do anything wrong?
B描述在主人面前打开礼物，问这是否也不礼貌，选Was that impolite too?
下文回答“Yes, I also talked about salary...”，问是否还有其他差异，选Are there any other differences?

text:
A: Hi, Peter! I hear you went to the library yesterday. ___1___
B: I went there with my classmate, Jack.
A: ___2___
B: We read a book about the world's highest mountain.
A: Qomolangma? ___3___
B: It's about 8,848.86 meters high. It's the highest mountain in the world.
A: That's amazing. ___4___
B: It's in the Himalayas, on the border between China and Nepal.
A: ___5___
B: Yes, but climbing it is very dangerous because of the cold weather and heavy storms.
translation: A：嗨，彼得！我听说你昨天去图书馆了。你和谁一起去的？ B：我和我的同学杰克一起去的。 A：你们读了什么？ B：我们读了一本关于世界最高山的书。 A：珠穆朗玛峰？它有多高？ B：它大约8848.86米高。它是世界最高峰。 A：太神奇了。它在哪里？ B：它在喜马拉雅山脉，位于中国和尼泊尔的边界上。 A：很多人尝试攀登它吗？ B：是的，但由于寒冷的天气和猛烈的风暴，攀登它非常危险。
options: Do many people try to climb it?
How long did you stay there?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“I went there with my classmate, Jack.”，问和谁一起去的，选Who did you go with?
下文回答“We read a book about...”，问读了什么，选What did you read?
下文回答“It's about 8,848.86 meters high.”，问高度，选How high is it?
下文回答“It's in the Himalayas...”，问位置，选Where is it?
下文回答“Yes, but climbing it is very dangerous...”，问是否有很多人尝试攀登，选Do many people try to climb it?

text:
A: Hi, Emily! ___1___
B: I'm looking at my photos from the space museum.
A: The space museum? ___2___
B: Yes, I have. I went there last month. It was fantastic.
A: ___3___
B: I saw a real rocket and learned how astronauts live in space.
A: That sounds cool. ___4___
B: I went with my science teacher and my classmates.
A: ___5___
B: Yes, we did. We took a lot of photos and bought some model rockets.
translation: A：嗨，艾米丽！你在做什么？ B：我在看我在太空博物馆拍的照片。 A：太空博物馆？你去过那里吗？ B：是的，我去过。我上个月去的。太棒了。 A：你在那里看到了什么？ B：我看到了一枚真正的火箭，还了解了宇航员如何在太空生活。 A：听起来很酷。你和谁一起去的？ B：我和我的科学老师以及同学们一起去的。 A：你们买东西了吗？ B：是的，我们拍了很多照片，还买了一些模型火箭。

questions.explanation: 下文回答“I'm looking at my photos...”，问正在做什么，选What are you doing?
下文回答“Yes, I have.”，问是否去过那里，选Have you ever been there?
下文回答“I saw a real rocket...”，问看到了什么，选What did you see there?
下文回答“I went with my science teacher...”，问和谁一起去的，选Who did you go with?
下文回答“Yes, we did. We took a lot of photos and bought...”，问是否买东西了，选Did you buy anything?

text:
A: Excuse me, could you please tell me where the nearest bank is?
B: Sure. ___1___
A: Is it far from here?
B: ___2___ It's about ten minutes' walk.
A: ___3___
B: Go along this street and turn right at the second crossing. ___4___
A: Thank you very much.
B: ___5___
translation: A：打扰一下，你能告诉我最近的银行在哪里吗？ B：当然。一直往前走。 A：离这里远吗？ B：不远。大约走十分钟。 A：我怎么到那里？ B：沿着这条街走，在第二个十字路口右转。银行在你的左边。 A：非常感谢。 B：不客气。
options: The bank is on your left.

questions.explanation: 开始指路，选Go straight ahead.
下文说“It's about ten minutes' walk.”，说明不远，选No, it isn't.
下文详细说明路线，问怎么到那里，选How can I get there?
指路最后说明目的地方位，选The bank is on your left.
回应感谢，选You're welcome.

text:
A: What kind of music do you like, Scott?
B: ___1___ I can sing along with it.
A: I like music that has great lyrics. ___2___
B: I also like movies that are funny. What about you?
A: ___3___ I think action movies are exciting.
B: ___4___
A: My favorite actor is Jackie Chan. He is really funny and skillful.
B: ___5___ I like him too.
translation: A：斯科特，你喜欢什么类型的音乐？ B：我喜欢能跟着唱的音乐。 A：我喜欢歌词优美的音乐。你喜欢什么类型的电影？ B：我也喜欢有趣的电影。你呢？ A：我喜欢动作电影。我觉得动作电影很刺激。 B：你最喜欢的演员是谁？ A：我最喜欢的演员是成龙。他真的很幽默，也很有技巧。 B：我同意。我也喜欢他。
options: I like music that I can dance to.
What kind of movies do you like?

questions.explanation: 后文说“I can sing along with it.”，说明喜欢能跟着唱的音乐，选I like music that I can dance to.
下文回答“I also like movies that are funny.”，问对方喜欢什么电影，选What kind of movies do you like?
下文说“I think action movies are exciting.”，说明喜欢动作片，选I prefer action movies.
下文回答“My favorite actor is Jackie Chan.”，问最喜欢的演员，选Who is your favorite actor?
后文说“I like him too.”，表示同意，选I agree.

text:
A: Hi, Wendy! You're going to China as an exchange student, right?
B: Yes. ___1___
A: Don't worry. Let me tell you some Chinese customs.
B: Great! ___2___
A: When you meet someone for the first time, you're supposed to shake hands.
B: I see. ___3___
A: At the dinner table, you shouldn't stick your chopsticks into the rice.
B: OK. ___4___
A: You're supposed to let the elder start eating first.
B: ___5___ Thank you for telling me.
translation: A：嗨，温迪！你要作为交换生去中国，是吗？ B：是的。但我不知道中国的风俗习惯。 A：别担心。让我告诉你一些中国习俗。 B：太好了！我应该做什么？ A：当你第一次见到某人时，你应该握手。 B：我明白了。在餐桌上我该怎么做？ A：在餐桌上，你不应该把筷子插进米饭里。 B：好的。还有其他规则吗？ A：你应该让长辈先吃。 B：我知道了。谢谢你告诉我。
options: But I don't know the customs.
What am I supposed to do?
What should I do at the dinner table?

questions.explanation: 下文说“Let me tell you some Chinese customs.”，说明B不了解习俗，选But I don't know the customs.
下文回答“you're supposed to shake hands.”，问应该做什么，选What am I supposed to do?
下文回答“At the dinner table, you shouldn't...”，问餐桌上怎么做，选What should I do at the dinner table?
下文回答“You're supposed to let the elder start eating first.”，问是否还有其他规则，选Are there any other rules?
表示明白了，选I see.

text:
A: Hi, Grace! How was your school trip last week?
B: ___1___ We went to a farm.
A: A farm? ___2___
B: We picked apples and fed the chickens.
A: That sounds fun. ___3___
B: It was sunny and warm. The air was very clean.
A: ___4___
B: Yes, I did. I had a great time there.
A: ___5___
B: Sure. Here are some photos.
translation: A：嗨，格蕾丝！你上周的学校旅行怎么样？ B：太棒了！我们去了一个农场。 A：农场？你们在那里做了什么？ B：我们摘了苹果，喂了鸡。 A：听起来很有趣。天气怎么样？ B：晴朗温暖。空气很干净。 A：你玩得开心吗？ B：是的。我在那里玩得很开心。 A：我能看看照片吗？ B：当然。这些是照片。
options: Did you have a good time?

questions.explanation: 下文说“We went to a farm.”，评价旅行，选It was great!
下文回答“We picked apples and fed the chickens.”，问做了什么，选What did you do there?
下文回答“It was sunny and warm.”，问天气，选How was the weather?
下文回答“Yes, I did. I had a great time there.”，问是否玩得开心，选Did you have a good time?
下文回答“Sure. Here are some photos.”，请求看照片，选Can I see the photos?

text:
A: Hi, Tom! You look unhappy. ___1___
B: I had a fight with my cousin. He is angry with me.
A: ___2___
B: I broke his model plane by accident.
A: I see. ___3___ You should say sorry to him.
B: I know, but I'm afraid he won't forgive me.
A: ___4___ True friends always understand each other.
B: You're right. ___5___
A: You can also buy him a new model plane.
translation: A：嗨，汤姆！你看起来不开心。怎么了？ B：我和表弟吵架了。他生我的气。 A：发生什么事了？ B：我不小心弄坏了他的模型飞机。 A：我明白了。你应该向他道歉。 B：我知道，但我怕他不会原谅我。 A：别担心。真正的朋友总是互相理解。 B：你说得对。我还能做什么？ A：你也可以给他买一个新的模型飞机。
options: You should say sorry to him.
Did you buy him a gift?

questions.explanation: 下文描述吵架，问怎么了，选What's wrong?
下文解释弄坏模型飞机，问发生什么事了，选What happened?
给出具体建议，后文说“You should say sorry to him.”，选You should say sorry to him.
安慰对方，后文“True friends always understand each other.”衔接，选Don't worry.
下文回答“You can also buy him a new model plane.”，问还能做什么，选What else can I do?

text:
A: Hi, Lily! ___1___
B: I'm going to the bookstore. I want to buy a dictionary.
A: ___2___
B: I need it for my English study. I often forget new words.
A: ___3___
B: Yes, I do. I read English stories every day.
A: That's a good habit. ___4___
B: I usually read for about half an hour.
A: ___5___
B: You're right. I will keep doing it.
translation: A：嗨，莉莉！你要去哪里？ B：我去书店。我想买一本字典。 A：你为什么需要字典？ B：我学英语需要它。我经常忘记新单词。 A：你经常读英语故事吗？ B：是的。我每天读英语故事。 A：那是个好习惯。你通常读多久？ B：我通常读大约半小时。 A：坚持住。 B：你说得对。我会继续坚持。
options: Why do you need a dictionary?
Do you often read English stories?
How long do you usually read?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“I'm going to the bookstore.”，问去哪里，选Where are you going?
下文回答“I need it for my English study.”，问为什么需要字典，选Why do you need a dictionary?
下文回答“Yes, I do. I read English stories every day.”，问是否经常读英语故事，选Do you often read English stories?
下文回答“I usually read for about half an hour.”，问读多久，选How long do you usually read?
下文回答“You're right. I will keep doing it.”，鼓励坚持，选Keep it up.

text:
A: Hi, Mike! I hear you had a study trip last Saturday. ___1___
B: We went to Wenchang and Qionghai.
A: ___2___
B: First, we visited Haiwen Bridge. ___3___
A: Of course I have! It connects Haikou and Wenchang. It's very long.
B: Yes, it's about 5.6 kilometers long. Then we went to a space museum.
A: ___4___
B: We saw a rocket model and learned about space travel.
A: That sounds great. ___5___
B: We took a lot of photos and bought some postcards.
translation: A：嗨，迈克！我听说你上周六有一次研学旅行。你们去了哪里？ B：我们去了文昌和琼海。 A：你们在那里做了什么？ B：首先，我们参观了海文大桥。你听说过它吗？ A：当然听说过！它连接海口和文昌。它非常长。 B：是的，它大约5.6公里长。然后我们去了太空博物馆。 A：你们在那里看到了什么？ B：我们看到了一个火箭模型，还了解了太空旅行。 A：听起来很棒。你们买了什么吗？ B：我们拍了很多照片，还买了一些明信片。
options: Have you ever heard of it?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“We went to Wenchang and Qionghai.”，问去了哪里，选Where did you go?
下文描述参观活动，问做了什么，选What did you do there?
下文回答“Of course I have!”，问是否听说过海文大桥，选Have you ever heard of it?
下文回答“We saw a rocket model...”，问看到了什么，选What did you see there?
下文回答“We took a lot of photos and bought some postcards.”，问买了什么，选What did you buy?

text:
A: Hi, Julia! You look excited. ___1___
B: I just got a letter from my pen pal in Canada.
A: That's great! ___2___
B: She is thirteen years old, and she likes playing the piano.
A: ___3___
B: I'm going to write back and tell her about my school life.
A: ___4___
B: I'm going to send her some photos of my family too.
A: ___5___
B: Yes, I do. I hope she can visit China one day.
translation: A：嗨，朱莉娅！你看起来很兴奋。怎么了？ B：我刚收到加拿大笔友的一封信。 A：太棒了！她是什么样的人？ B：她十三岁，喜欢弹钢琴。 A：你打算怎么做？ B：我打算回信告诉她我的学校生活。 A：你还打算做什么？ B：我还打算给她寄一些我家人的照片。 A：你希望见到她吗？ B：是的。我希望有一天她能来中国。
options: What are you going to do?
What else are you going to do?
Do you hope to meet her?

questions.explanation: 下文解释收到笔友来信，问怎么了，选What's up?
下文回答年龄和爱好，问笔友是什么样的人，选What is she like?
下文回答“I'm going to write back...”，问打算怎么做，选What are you going to do?
下文回答“I'm going to send her some photos... too.”，问还打算做什么，选What else are you going to do?
下文回答“Yes, I do. I hope she can visit China one day.”，问是否希望见到她，选Do you hope to meet her?

text:
A: Hi, Sam! You look tired. ___1___
B: I stayed up late to finish my science project.
A: ___2___ How long did you sleep last night?
B: Only about four hours.
A: ___3___ You need at least eight hours of sleep.
B: I know. But I have to hand it in tomorrow.
A: ___4___ You can finish the rest after a short rest.
B: That's a good idea. ___5___
A: You're welcome. Take care of yourself.
translation: A：嗨，山姆！你看起来很累。怎么了？ B：我熬夜完成科学项目。 A：那对健康不好。你昨晚睡了多久？ B：只有大约四个小时。 A：你应该多睡觉。你至少需要八个小时的睡眠。 B：我知道。但我明天必须交。 A：你应该休息一下。你可以休息一会儿后再完成剩下的。 B：好主意。谢谢你的建议。 A：不客气。照顾好自己。
options: Why don't you go to bed early?
How much sleep do you need?

questions.explanation: 下文解释熬夜，问怎么了，选What's the matter?
得知熬夜后给出评价，后文问睡眠时长，选That's bad for your health.
下文说只睡四小时，建议多睡觉，选You should get more sleep.
建议先休息，后文“after a short rest”呼应，选You should take a rest.
回应“You're welcome.”，表示感谢，选Thanks for your advice.

text:
A: Hi, David! The summer holiday is coming. ___1___
B: I'm going to visit my grandparents in the countryside.
A: ___2___
B: I'm going there by train.
A: ___3___
B: I'm going to stay there for about three weeks.
A: ___4___
B: I'm going to help my grandparents with the farm work and enjoy the fresh air.
A: That sounds great. ___5___
B: Thank you! I will send you some photos.
translation: A：嗨，大卫！暑假要到了。你打算做什么？ B：我打算去乡下看望我的祖父母。 A：你怎么去那里？ B：我坐火车去。 A：你打算在那里待多久？ B：我打算在那里待大约三周。 A：你打算在那里做什么？ B：我打算帮祖父母干农活，享受新鲜空气。 A：听起来很棒。祝你玩得开心。 B：谢谢！我会给你发一些照片。
options: What are you going to do this summer?
How long are you going to stay there?
What are you going to do there?

Why do you need those books?
What animals are you going to write about?
When are you going to finish it?

questions.explanation: B回答“I'm going to the library.”，问周末打算做什么，选What are you going to do this weekend?
B回答“Because I'm writing a report...”，问为什么需要这些书，选Why do you need those books?
B回答“I'm going to write about pandas and tigers.”，问打算写什么动物，选What animals are you going to write about?
B回答“I plan to finish it this weekend.”，问什么时候完成，选When are you going to finish it?
B回答“Thank you.”，表达祝愿，选Good luck with your report.

text:
A: Hi, Tom! You look upset. ___1___
B: I argued with my best friend. He doesn't want to talk to me.
A: I'm sorry to hear that. ___2___
B: Because I forgot his birthday. I feel really bad.
A: Everyone makes mistakes. ___3___
B: You're right. But I'm afraid he won't forgive me.
A: ___4___ True friends always understand each other.
B: I hope so. ___5___
A: You can also buy him a small gift and say sorry.
translation: A：嗨，汤姆！你看起来不开心。怎么了？ B：我和最好的朋友吵架了。他不想和我说话。 A：听到这个我很难过。你们为什么吵架？ B：因为我忘了他的生日。我感觉很糟糕。 A：每个人都会犯错。你应该向他道歉。 B：你说得对。但我怕他不会原谅我。 A：别担心。真正的朋友总是互相理解。 B：希望如此。我还能做什么？ A：你也可以给他买个小礼物并道歉。
options: You should say sorry to him.
Did you buy him a gift?

questions.explanation: B描述吵架，问怎么了，选What's wrong?
B回答“Because I forgot his birthday.”，问原因，选Why did you argue?
A安慰后给出道歉建议，选You should say sorry to him.
B担心不被原谅，A安慰别担心，选Don't worry.
A回答“You can also buy him a small gift...”，问还能做什么，选What else can I do?

text:
A: Hi, Amy! You look excited. ___1___
B: I just got a letter from my pen pal in Australia.
A: That's great! ___2___
B: She is thirteen years old, and she likes playing tennis.
A: ___3___
B: I'm going to write back and tell her about my school life.
A: ___4___
B: I'm going to send her some photos of my family too.
A: ___5___
B: Yes, I do. I hope she can visit China one day.
translation: A：嗨，艾米！你看起来很兴奋。怎么了？ B：我刚收到澳大利亚笔友的一封信。 A：太棒了！她是什么样的人？ B：她十三岁，喜欢打网球。 A：你打算怎么做？ B：我打算回信告诉她我的学校生活。 A：你还打算做什么？ B：我还打算给她寄一些我家人的照片。 A：你希望见到她吗？ B：是的。我希望有一天她能来中国。
options: What are you going to do?
What else are you going to do?
Do you hope to meet her?

questions.explanation: B解释收到笔友来信，问怎么了，选What's up?
B回答年龄和爱好，问笔友是什么样的人，选What is she like?
B回答“I'm going to write back...”，问打算怎么做，选What are you going to do?
B回答“I'm going to send her some photos... too.”，问还打算做什么，选What else are you going to do?
B回答“Yes, I do. I hope she can visit China one day.”，问是否希望见到她，选Do you hope to meet her?

text:
A: Hi, Jack! You look sleepy. ___1___
B: I went to bed too late last night. I was doing my math homework.
A: ___2___ You should go to bed earlier.
B: I know. But the homework was really difficult.
A: ___3___
B: I started at 8:00 p.m. and finished at 11:30 p.m.
A: That's too long. ___4___
B: You're right. I'll ask my teacher for help next time.
A: ___5___
translation: A：嗨，杰克！你看起来很困。怎么了？ B：我昨晚睡得太晚了。我在做数学作业。 A：那对健康不好。你应该早点睡。 B：我知道。但作业真的很难。 A：你什么时候开始做的？ B：晚上8点开始，11点半做完。 A：太久了。你最好下次向老师求助。 B：你说得对。下次我会向老师求助。 A：那是个好主意。
options: You'd better ask your teacher for help next time.
Why don't you go to bed now?

questions.explanation: B解释熬夜，问怎么了，选What's the matter?
得知熬夜后给出评价，后文“You should go to bed earlier”衔接，选That's bad for your health.
B回答“I started at 8:00 p.m. and finished at 11:30 p.m.”，问什么时候开始做的，选When did you start?
觉得时间太久，建议向老师求助，B回答“I'll ask my teacher for help next time.”，选You'd better ask your teacher for help next time.
B接受建议，A表示肯定，选That's a good idea.

text:
A: Hi, Li Lei. ___1___
B: I want to join the music club.
A: Oh. ___2___
B: Yes, I can. I can sing well.
A: ___3___
B: No, I can't. But I can play the piano.
A: Really? ___4___
B: I can play it, too. ___5___
A: OK. Let's play chess now.
translation: A：嗨，李磊。你想加入什么俱乐部？ B：我想加入音乐俱乐部。 A：哦。你会唱歌吗？ B：是的，我会。我唱得很好。 A：你会下象棋吗？ B：不，我不会。但我会弹钢琴。 A：真的吗？你会弹吉他吗？ B：我也会弹。我们现在下棋吧。 A：好的。我们现在下棋吧。
options: What club do you want to join?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“I want to join the music club.”，问想加入什么俱乐部，选What club do you want to join?
下文回答“Yes, I can. I can sing well.”，问是否会唱歌，选Can you sing?
下文回答“No, I can't. But I can play the piano.”，问是否会下象棋，选Can you play chess?
下文回答“I can play it, too.”，问是否会弹吉他，选Can you play the guitar?
上文说“OK. Let's play chess now.”，此处提出下棋的建议，选Let's play chess now.

text:
A: Lucy, are there any rules in the library?
B: ___1___ For example, we can't make noise.
A: OK. ___2___ Can we eat snacks quietly?
B: No, we can't. ___3___
A: I will keep the library clean. ___4___
B: We mustn't take the books home.
A: ___5___
B: You should use your student card to borrow them.
translation: A：露西，图书馆里有什么规则吗？ B：是的，有。例如，我们不能制造噪音。 A：好的。还有别的吗？我们可以安静地吃零食吗？ B：不，不可以。我们也不能乱扔垃圾。 A：我会保持图书馆干净。还有什么？ B：我们不能把书带回家。 A：如果我想在家读这些书该怎么办？ B：你应该用学生证借它们。
options: What should I do if I need to read them at home?

questions.explanation: 下文举例“we can't make noise”，问是否有规则，肯定回答，选Yes, there are.
下文继续询问“Can we eat snacks quietly?”，问还有没有其他规则，选Anything else?
上文说不能吃零食，此处补充另一条禁止性规则，选We can't litter either.
下文回答“We mustn't take the books home.”，问还有什么规则，选What else?
下文回答“You should use your student card to borrow them.”，问在家阅读该怎么办，选What should I do if I need to read them at home?

text:
A: Excuse me. ___1___
B: Go along this street and turn left at the first crossing. The museum is next to the bank.
A: ___2___
B: It's only about twenty minutes on foot.
A: I see. ___3___
B: Yes, you can. The No. 8 bus will take you there.
A: ___4___
B: The bus stop? Oh, it's over there. Look! The bus is coming.
A: ___5___
translation: A：打扰一下。去博物馆怎么走？ B：沿着这条街走，在第一个十字路口左转。博物馆在银行旁边。 A：从这儿到那儿有多远？ B：步行大约只要二十分钟。 A：我明白了。我可以坐公交车去那儿吗？ B：是的，可以。8路公交车会带你到那儿。 A：公交车站在哪里？ B：公交车站？哦，在那边。看！公交车来了。 A：非常感谢。
options: How can I get to the museum?
How far is it from here?
Can I take a bus there?

questions.explanation: 下文给出详细路线，问怎么去博物馆，选How can I get to the museum?
下文回答“about twenty minutes on foot”，问距离，选How far is it from here?
下文回答“Yes, you can. The No. 8 bus...”，问是否可以坐公交车，选Can I take a bus there?
下文回答“The bus stop? Oh, it's over there.”，问公交车站在哪里，选Where is the bus stop?
对话结尾表示感谢，选Thank you very much.

text:
A: Good afternoon, young man. ___1___
B: Good afternoon, doctor. I don't feel well. I have a headache.
A: ___2___
B: No, I don't. But I feel a little cold.
A: Oh, I think you may have a cold.
B: ___3___
A: You should drink much water.
B: OK. ___4___
A: Well, you should go to bed early and have a good rest.
B: ___5___
A: No. It's nothing serious, so you can go to school.
translation: A：下午好，年轻人。怎么了？ B：下午好，医生。我不舒服。我头疼。 A：你发烧吗？ B：不，我没有。但我觉得有点冷。 A：哦，我想你可能感冒了。 B：我该怎么办？ A：你应该多喝水。 B：好的。还应该做什么？ A：嗯，你应该早点睡觉，好好休息。 B：我应该卧床休息吗？ A：不。没什么严重的，所以你可以去上学。

questions.explanation: 下文描述“I have a headache.”，医生询问病情，选What's the matter?
下文回答“No, I don't.”，问是否发烧，选Do you have a fever?
下文给出建议“You should drink much water.”，问该怎么办，选What should I do?
下文继续给出建议“you should go to bed early”，问还应该做什么，选What else?
下文回答“No. It's nothing serious”，问是否需要卧床，选Should I stay in bed?

text:
A: Welcome to Joy Theater. May I help you?
B: Yes. ___1___
A: Yes. There will be an outdoor concert on Saturday night.
B: Can you tell me more about the concert?
A: Sure. ___2___
B: Great. ___3___
A: No, some are very cheap. The price depends on the seat.
B: ___4___
A: I mean that it's 300 for a front seat and it's 50 for a back seat.
B: I see. ___5___
A: Sure. No problem.
translation: A：欢迎来到欢乐剧院。需要帮忙吗？ B：是的。这个周末我想去听音乐会。 A：好的。周六晚上有一场户外音乐会。 B：你能多告诉我一些关于音乐会的事吗？ A：当然。许多歌手和演员会在音乐会上演出。 B：太好了。票贵吗？ A：不，有些很便宜。价格取决于座位。 B：你这是什么意思？ A：我的意思是前排座位300，后排座位50。 B：我明白了。那我可以买两张前排票吗？ A：当然。没问题。
options: I'd like to go to a concert this weekend.
A lot of singers and actors will appear at the concert.
What do you mean by that?
Then can I have two front seat tickets?
Do you have any plans for this weekend?

questions.explanation: 下文介绍周六晚上的音乐会，说明B想去听音乐会，选I'd like to go to a concert this weekend.
上文问“Can you tell me more about the concert?”，此处补充音乐会细节，选A lot of singers and actors will appear at the concert.
下文回答“No, some are very cheap.”，问票是否贵，选Are the tickets expensive?
下文解释价格含义，问“你这是什么意思”，选What do you mean by that?
下文回答“Sure. No problem.”，提出购买具体票务请求，选Then can I have two front seat tickets?

text:
A: Hi, Mom. Could I invite some friends to a party?
B: ___1___
A: What do I have to do?
B: Well, first you should sweep the kitchen.
A: OK. ___2___
B: Then you should clean the living room.
A: Yeah. ___3___
B: And you need to clean your room.
A: Wow! ___4___
B: I'll help you. I'm going to the store to buy some drinks and snacks.
A: ___5___
translation: A：嗨，妈妈。我可以邀请一些朋友来参加派对吗？ B：当然可以。 A：我必须做什么？ B：嗯，首先你应该打扫厨房。 A：好的。然后呢？ B：然后你应该打扫客厅。 A：好的。还做什么？ B：你还需要打扫你的房间。 A：哇！我会累得去不了自己的派对的！ B：我会帮你的。我要去商店买一些饮料和零食。 A：谢谢妈妈。
options: I'm going to be tired to go to my own party!

questions.explanation: 下文问“What do I have to do?”，说明妈妈同意了，选Sure, you can.
下文继续提出家务“Then you should clean the living room.”，问然后呢，选Then what?
下文说“And you need to clean your room.”，问还做什么，选What else?
上文列举多项家务后，A发出感叹，选I'm going to be tired to go to my own party!
妈妈提出帮忙买东西，A表示感谢，选Thanks, Mom.

text:
A: Hi, Jane. Don't you recognize me?
B: Oh, you're Kate. ___1___
A: Really? How?
B: You used to be a little heavy, but now you're thin.
A: Yes, I am. ___2___ Now you have curly hair.
B: Yes, you're right.
A: ___3___
B: Yes, I still do.
A: You used to play the piano, didn't you?
B: Yes, I did. ___4___
A: Wow! People always change.
B: ___5___
translation: A：嗨，简。你不认识我了吗？ B：哦，你是凯特。你变化很大。 A：真的吗？怎么变了？ B：你以前有点胖，但现在很瘦。 A：是的。你以前戴眼镜。现在你留卷发。 B：是的，你说得对。 A：你以前很外向，是吗？ B：是的，我现在还是。 A：你以前弹钢琴，是吗？ B：是的。但现在我对小提琴更感兴趣。 A：哇！人总是会变的。 B：那是当然。
options: And you used to wear glasses.
You used to be very outgoing, didn't you?
But now I'm more interested in the violin.
You used to have straight hair.
I didn't use to like tests.

questions.explanation: 下文问“How?”，说明B感叹A变化很大，选You've changed a lot.
后文说“Now you have curly hair.”，此处应描述对方过去的外貌特征，选And you used to wear glasses.
下文回答“Yes, I still do.”，问过去是否具有某种性格，选You used to be very outgoing, didn't you?
上文问是否过去弹钢琴，回答Yes后补充现在的变化，选But now I'm more interested in the violin.
上文说“People always change.”，表示同意，选That's for sure.

text:
A: Hi, Tom! Can you help me think of one of the greatest inventions in the world?
B: ___1___ Hmm... the telephone.
A: Why do you think so?
B: ___2___ It helps people a lot.
A: ___3___
B: It was invented in 1876.
A: Do you think it was invented after the car?
B: ___4___ I think it was invented before the car.
A: ___5___
B: It was used for talking with people.
translation: A：嗨，汤姆！你能帮我想一个世界上最伟大的发明吗？ B：我很乐意。嗯……电话。 A：你为什么这么认为？ B：因为它在全世界被广泛使用。它帮助人们很多。 A：它是什么时候发明的？ B：它是在1876年发明的。 A：你认为它是在汽车之后发明的吗？ B：不，我不这么认为。我认为它是在汽车之前发明的。 A：它是用来做什么的？ B：它是用来和人们通话的。
options: Because it is used widely around the world today.

questions.explanation: 上文请求帮助，下文接受并开始思考，选With pleasure.
上文问“Why do you think so?”，说明原因，选Because it is used widely around the world today.
下文回答“It was invented in 1876.”，问发明时间，选When was it invented?
下文说“I think it was invented before the car.”，否定对方猜测，选No, I don't think so.
下文回答“It was used for talking with people.”，问用途，选What was it used for?

text:
A: Hi, Anna! I didn't see you at school yesterday. ___1___
B: I didn't feel very well. I coughed and had a fever.
A: ___2___
B: Yes, the doctor took my temperature and said I had a cold.
A: ___3___
B: He told me to take some medicine and drink more water.
A: ___4___
B: I feel much better now. Thank you.
A: ___5___ You should take good care of yourself.
translation: A：嗨，安娜！我昨天在学校没看到你。你怎么了？ B：我不舒服。我咳嗽还发烧。 A：你看医生了吗？ B：是的，医生量了我的体温，说我感冒了。 A：医生让你做什么？ B：他让我吃药，多喝水。 A：你现在感觉怎么样？ B：我现在好多了。谢谢。 A：不客气。你应该好好照顾自己。
options: What did the doctor tell you to do?

questions.explanation: 下文描述症状“I coughed and had a fever.”，问怎么了，选What's the matter?
下文回答“Yes, the doctor took my temperature...”，问是否看医生了，选Did you see a doctor?
下文回答“He told me to take some medicine...”，问医生让做什么，选What did the doctor tell you to do?
下文回答“I feel much better now.”，问现在感觉怎么样，选How do you feel now?
对方感谢后礼貌回应，选You're welcome.

text:
A: Hi, Mike! I hear you volunteered at the city park last weekend. ___1___
B: It was meaningful. We planted trees and picked up rubbish.
A: ___2___
B: About twenty volunteers.
A: ___3___
B: We worked from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
A: That was a long day. ___4___
B: Yes, I did. I felt tired but happy.
A: ___5___
B: Of course! You can join us next time.
translation: A：嗨，迈克！我听说你上周末在城市公园做志愿者了。怎么样？ B：很有意义。我们种树、捡垃圾。 A：有多少志愿者？ B：大约二十个。 A：你们工作了多久？ B：我们从上午9点工作到下午4点。 A：真是漫长的一天。你感到累吗？ B：是的。我觉得累但开心。 A：我能加入你们吗？ B：当然！下次你可以加入我们。

questions.explanation: 下文评价“It was meaningful.”，问志愿活动怎么样，选How was it?
下文回答“About twenty volunteers.”，问有多少志愿者，选How many volunteers were there?
下文回答“from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.”，问工作了多久，选How long did you work?
下文回答“Yes, I did. I felt tired but happy.”，问是否感到累，选Did you feel tired?
下文回答“Of course! You can join us next time.”，请求加入，选Can I join you?

text:

B: Sure. What do you want to do on it?

options: What do you need me to do?
Could you please clean your room?
Do you hate to do chores?

questions.explanation: 下文回答“Sure. What do you want to do on it?”，请求使用手机，选Could I use your phone?
下文回答“Could you please help me clean the living room?”，问需要对方做什么，选What do you need me to do?
下文说“I'm going to sweep the floor”，表示同意帮忙，选No problem.
下文回答“Yes, you can.”，请求邀请朋友，选Can I invite my friends?

text:
A: Hi, Wang Lei. I think you have changed a lot in the last few years.
B: Yes, I have changed a lot.
A: ___1___ But now you are tall.
B: Yes, I used to be short. You were much taller than me in the past.
A: ___2___
B: Yes, I used to like playing basketball, but now I don't have much time to play it.
A: ___3___
B: Yes, I used to be afraid of snakes, and now I'm still afraid of them.
A: I remember you used to like painting pictures. ___4___
B: But now I like singing and dancing.
A: ___5___
B: Yes, but I am not afraid of the dark now. I think I have grown up.
translation: A：嗨，王磊。我觉得你过去几年变化很大。 B：是的，我变化很大。 A：你以前很矮，但现在很高。 B：是的，我以前很矮。你过去比我高很多。 A：你以前喜欢打篮球，是吗？ B：是的，我以前喜欢打篮球，但现在没有太多时间打。 A：你以前怕蛇，是吗？ B：是的，我以前怕蛇，现在还是怕。 A：我记得你以前喜欢画画。你现在还喜欢吗？ B：但现在我喜欢唱歌跳舞。 A：你以前怕黑，是吗？ B：是的，但我现在不怕黑了。我觉得我长大了。
options: You used to like playing basketball, didn't you?
You used to be afraid of snakes, didn't you?
You used to be afraid of the dark, didn't you?
You used to have long hair.
